name: g05-bug
prompt:
ENG-G05 (cascaded shadow maps). Add one row to the table whose header is `| ID | Area | Symptom | Root cause | Fix | Session |`, directly after the row that starts `| BUG-088 |`. The row is one line, cells in this order:
ID `BUG-089`; Area `Rendering / ShadowMap`; Symptom: every caster nearer the sun than the middle of the shadow map cast no shadow, so in a wide view about half the walls, steps and characters had none (cookbook maze.lua showed it); Root cause: `ShadowMap::computeLightViewProj` used `glm::ortho`, whose depth is -1..1 (OpenGL); Vulkan clips depth below 0, so those casters were never drawn into the map; Fix: `glm::orthoRH_ZO` (depth 0..1) and half the receiver bias in `computeShadow`, with the test `ShadowProjection.DepthCoversTheWholeBoxInVulkanRange` (ENG-G05); Session: `Found by the ENG-G05 picture check (2026-10-13)`. Put code names in backticks as shown. Change nothing else.
